conclusions.observed: Original command reaches native input. On red runs process_input_message consumes Ctrl-O after another thread removes the earlier resize events; read(0) returns only the following 92 bytes. Diagnostic green returns all 93 bytes.
conclusions.source_inference: send_winch_maybe temporarily releases input_mutex; the saved PeekConsoleInput snapshot can become stale before discard. Function-boundary observation confirms the corresponding cross-thread order, not a tested patch.
